vibe_rationale: Ten-year, Ubud-rooted food festival with a farmer and sustainability theme that is curated and community-trusted, but food-only and tourist-facing, so narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Health-adjacent through food, farming and sustainability, with free general entry and long dwell time that suits a tasting, workshop or hydration strand. A published partners page and a sponsor list of hotels, restaurants and drinks brands show the route is open. Australians were the largest source of Bali arrivals in 2025 (23.44 per cent, BPS Bali), though the event share is not published.
